name: micro-frontend-ecommerce
description: Frontend-only e-commerce demo built as micro frontends with Vite Module Federation

scripts.build:remotes: npm run build -w remote-catalog && npm run build -w remote-cart && npm run build -w remote-checkout
scripts.dev: npm run build:remotes && concurrently -k -n catalog,cart,checkout,host -c magenta,cyan,yellow,green "npm run serve -w remote-catalog" "npm run serve -w remote-cart" "npm run serve -w remote-checkout" "npm run dev -w host"
scripts.watch: npm run build:remotes && concurrently -k -n cat:build,cat:serve,crt:build,crt:serve,chk:build,chk:serve,host -c magenta,magenta,cyan,cyan,yellow,yellow,green "npm run watch -w remote-catalog" "npm run serve -w remote-catalog" "npm run watch -w remote-cart" "npm run serve -w remote-cart" "npm run watch -w remote-checkout" "npm run serve -w remote-checkout" "npm run dev -w host"
scripts.build: npm run build:remotes && npm run build -w host && node scripts/bundle-remotes.mjs
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run serve -w host
